QUOTE: "`do_count_tokens` (`:825`) returns 0. `entropic_inference_count_tokens` (`inference_c_api.cpp:548`) passes that 0 straight to the C caller. The `len/4` estimate only runs when an exception is thrown, so a llama.cpp failure reads as a zero-token count."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the token-counting path returns 0 on tokenization failure instead of signalling an error.
